verdict.rationale: The only evidence of acting on many items at once is batch-style test execution: marketing copy about running thousands of synthetic conversations and running the same scenarios across platforms and models, plus a CLI and SDK that manage agents, scenarios, runs and call data, which could be scripted over many items. No bulk endpoint or bulk command is actually documented. Missing for 10: explicit bulk create/update/delete operations for agents, scenarios or calls; documented batch API or CLI commands; any hands-on or independent corroboration.
